{{Short description|Norwegian physiologist}}
'''Kristian Gundersen''' (born 1959)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://tidsskriftet.no/profil/kristian-gundersen|title=Kristian Gundersen Forfatterinformasjon|publisher=[[Journal of the Norwegian Medical Association]]|language=no|access-date=10 September 2026}}</ref> is a Norwegian physiologist.

==Career==
Graduating from the [[University of Oslo]] with the [[cand.scient.]] degree in 1981, he took the [[dr.philos.]] degree at the Faculty of Medicine in 1989. He was a [[postdoctoral fellow]] at the [[Washington University Medical School]] from 1990 to 1992 and the University of Oslo from 1993 to 1996 before being employed as a professor of biology in 1996.<ref name=board>{{cite web|url=https://www.uio.no/om/organisasjon/valg/styrevalg/tidligere-valg/2013/kristian-gundersen.html|title=Professor Kristian Gundersen, Institutt for biovitenskap|year=2013|publisher=University of Oslo|language=no|access-date=9 September 2026}}</ref> He is a fellow of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]].

==Views on science and academia==
Gundersen sees academic research as a "calling" which requires a "formidable" work ethic, around-the-clock "living within the research questions" and dedication beyond standard working hours, which he regards as being at odds with the "Norwegian work ethic".<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.khrono.no/svarer-langsom-professor-ikke-mulig-a-drive-toppforskning-med-norsk-arbeidsmoral/1021527|title=Svarer «langsom professor»: — Ikke mulig å drive toppforskning med norsk arbeidsmoral|date=10 December 2025|author=Hystad, Joar|work=Khrono|language=no|access-date=9 September 2026}}</ref> Gundersen sat on the Academic College of the University of Oslo and later on the university board that succeeded it. In running a university, Gundersen voiced a strong desire to "combat [[new public management]]", fund [[basic research]] and lessen the role of research grants from outside councils.<ref name=board/><ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.universitas.no/styrevalg/kritiserer-strategisk-taketale/203389|title=Kritiserer «strategisk tåketale»|author=Molnes, Geir|date=15 May 2013|work=Universitas|language=no|access-date=9 September 2026}}</ref> He has deplored specific grants from the [[Norwegian Research Council]] as "scandalous".<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.universitas.no/den-beste-forskningen-blir-oversett/188821|title=– Den beste forskningen blir oversett|last=Wangen|first=Kenneth|date=15 January 2014|work=Universitas|language=no|access-date=10 September 2026}}</ref> Due to the perceived control of research and funding by administrative bodies, Gundersen has postulated that "Academic freedom exists no longer".<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.aftenposten.no/meninger/debatt/i/3p6gL9/akademisk-frihet-svekkes-i-norge-hva-skjer-med-universitetene|title=Akademisk frihet finnes ikke lenger|author=Gundersen, Kristian|date=11 February 2026|work=Aftenposten|language=no|access-date=9 September 2026}}</ref>

Furthermore he lambasted the endeavour to create a vision for the University of Oslo, which he called "maybe fitting in McDonald's", a case of "management hysteria", "drivel", "almost an insult to grown-ups" and "almost childish".<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.khrono.no/universitetet-i-oslo-visjon-kristian-gundersen/man-bor-ikke-bruke-tid-pa-sant-vrovl-det-er-virkelig-bortkastet-arbeid/158589|title="Man bør ikke bruke tid på sånt vrøvl, det er virkelig bortkastet arbeid"|author=Larsen, Hege|date=30 March 2016|work=Khrono|language=no|access-date=9 September 2026}}</ref> Gundersen has called for a better legal framework defending [[freedom of expression]],<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.khrono.no/faktaundersokelser-kristian-gundersen-steinnes/professor-kristian-gundersen-om-faktarapport-rettsstridig-holdning-til-ytringsfrihet/292079|title=Professor Kristian Gundersen om faktarapport: Rettsstridig holdning til ytringsfrihet|author=Tønnessen, Eva|date=15 July 2019|work=Khrono|language=no|access-date=9 September 2026}}</ref> has criticized [[political correctness]], [[post-modernism]] and "nonsensical" science, forms of [[Affirmative action|gender affirmative action]] and [[niqab ban|calls to ban the niqab and other clothing articles]] which he finds contrary to the purpose of a liberal institution.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.universitas.no/akademias-fremtid/kristian-gundersens-nadelose-oppgjor/137999|title=Kristian Gundersens nådeløse oppgjør|author=Vaaland, Mattis|date=24 October 2017|work=Universitas|language=no|access-date=9 September 2026}}</ref> While providing "lukewarm" and "conditional" support to the cause of [[Jordan Peterson]] he criticized the "far identity-political left" for constricting the [[Overton window]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.universitetsavisa.no/kierulf-utvalget-kristian-gundersen-ytringsfrihet/pussig-brak-og-pussig-leder/364041|title=Pussig bråk og pussig leder|date=2 June 2022|author=Gundersen, Kristian|work=Universitetsavisa|language=no|access-date=9 September 2026}}</ref>
